_doc: Classic Era hand-entered Rogue effects for calibration.

Remorseless Attacks.note: Crit on the first builder after a kill: leveling only. PvP (2026-09-27): low, burst: +40% crit on the next builder for 20 s after an honorable kill: chains battleground kills, nothing before the kill in a 1v1. The community seal fate build takes it as a tier-1 filler.

Ruthlessness.note: 20%/rank free CP after finishers: ~+2%/rank. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 1.1% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.1%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): low, burst: Finishers add a combo point 60% of the time: Kidney Shot then Eviscerate inside one stun. The sustained part is counted as damage (audit: medium).

Murder.note: +1%/rank vs Humanoid/Giant/Beast/Dragonkin: most raid bosses (x0.9), most leveling mobs (x0.7). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-26, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.8% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.28 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged. PvP damage (2026-09-27): every player is humanoid: the tooltip's full +1%/rank, of which the solo value counts 0.7%.

Improved Slice and Dice.note: +15%/rank duration. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 2.1% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Relentless Strikes.note: 25 energy per 5-CP finisher: ~+6% yellow output. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 3.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.7% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.7%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): low, burst: A 5-point finisher returns 25 Energy: Gouge, Kick or Blind right after Kidney Shot. The sustained part is counted as damage (audit: medium).

Improved Expose Armor.note: +25%/rank armor reduction: only if you are the Expose Armor rogue.

Improved Poisons.note: +2%/rank application chance on a ~20% base = +10%/rank relative poison damage. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stick: +10% poison application (Crippling 30 -> 40% per hit, also Wound and Mind-numbing): the snare and the healing cut come back faster after a dispel. Neither community build takes it.

Vile Poisons.note: +4%/rank poison damage. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, dispel: Poisons get +40% chance to resist dispels: Crippling, Wound and Mind-numbing survive Cleanse, Abolish Poison and Poison Cleansing Totem. The +20% poison damage is counted.

Improved Kidney Shot.note: PvP only (bosses are immune). PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: The target takes +9% from all sources while Kidney Shot lasts: the team's burst window. Core of the community seal fate build; the model gives it 0.

Seal Fate.note: 20%/rank extra CP on builder crits: raid ~+1.2%/rank, leveling ~+0.4%/rank. PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Builder crits add a second combo point (100% at 5/5): with Improved Backstab, 5 points in two or three globals for Kidney Shot and Cold Blood Eviscerate. The seal fate build's namesake.

Vigor.note: +10 max energy: ~+2% yellow. PvP (2026-09-27): low, burst: +10 max Energy: a bigger opener pool. It is the 31st Assassination point, which the 30/8/13 community build skips for Subtlety.

Cold Blood.note: Guaranteed crit every 3 min: ~+1%. PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Guaranteed crit on the next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush or Eviscerate: the Cold Blood Eviscerate or Ambush kill button. The sustained average (about 1%) misses it; both community PvP builds take it.

Malice.note: +1%/rank melee crit (parser could not scope 'your'). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 1.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Gouge.note: Leveling utility. 2026-09-27 audit: the sword loop never Gouges (fight lab 0.0 +-0.0 at 60); Gouge -> Backstab is the dagger loop before Mutilate. PvP (2026-09-27): high, stun: Gouge 4 -> 5.5 s incapacitate (10 s cd): the reset for bandage, Blind or Vanish and a second interrupt. Both community PvP builds take 3/3; the hemo build spends its only Combat points on it.

Riposte.note: 150% weapon damage + disarm after a parry: leveling ~+3%; raid 0. 2026-09-27 audit: the swords model already has a riposte source (5.2% leveling share): the manual +3% counted it twice. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: 6 s disarm after a parry (needs Deflection 5/5): shuts down warriors, rogues, paladins and enhancement shamans, nothing against casters. Combat builds only (audit: high; parry-gated and melee-only).

Improved Sprint.note: PvP. 2026-09-27 audit: it breaks snares when Sprint is cast and adds no speed; no leveling or raid use (PvP escape). PvP (2026-09-27): medium, escape: Sprint removes all snares and roots (100% at 2/2): the answer to Frost Nova, Hamstring, Concussive Shot and Entangling Roots. Combat builds (audit: high; one break per 5-min Sprint).

Improved Kick.note: Dungeon/PvP. 2026-09-27 audit: Kick's own 5 s lockout already stops a caster mob (fight lab -0.1% +-1.0 single-target and in pulls): +2 adds at 60 only. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: Kick silences for 2 s (100% at 2/2), locking every school, not only the kicked one: against healers and casters. Needs 15 Combat points; combat builds (audit: high).

Endurance.note: Shorter Sprint and Evasion cooldowns (Classic -1.5 min at 2/2): Evasion every 3.5 min instead of 5 while leveling -> +1.5%/rank survivability plus escape utility; raid filler. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, move: Sprint and Evasion cooldowns -90 s (5 -> 3.5 min): chase, escape, and Evasion against melee more often. Needs 10 Combat points; combat builds (audit: high; neither community build takes it).

Mace Specialization.note: Stun procs: PvP; weapon skill +1/rank minor. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: 6% chance per mace hit to stun for 3 s (5/5): free stuns for combat mace builds. Mace users only: the swords and daggers models must not count it.

Sword Specialization.note: 1%/rank extra attack after sword hits: ~+1%/rank damage with swords. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-swords-raid): removing it costs 2.7% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.6% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.6%). Other modes unchanged.

Dagger Specialization.note: +1%/rank crit with daggers (parser tagged 'Daggers'). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 1.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Blade Flurry.note: +20% attack speed 15s every 2 min (2.5% average white haste) and cleave. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 1.1% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.2%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, burst: +20% attack speed for 15 s (2 min cd) with more poison procs; the cleave hits hunter and warlock pets and totems but breaks your own Gouge, Blind and Sap on nearby enemies. Combat builds only (audit: low).

Weapon Expertise.note: +3/rank weapon skill (sword/fist/dagger): at 305 the glancing-blow penalty against level-63 bosses drops from ~35% to ~15% and hit/crit suppression eases: ~+2% then +2.5% white-heavy damage. Only raids (mobs of your level: 0). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 3.3% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 3.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Adrenaline Rush.note: Double energy 15s / 5 min: ~+5% yellow raid, +3% leveling. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 3.9% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 3.7% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.7%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Double Energy regeneration for 15 s (5 min cd): Kidney Shot, Gouge, Blind and two Eviscerates in one window, the combat PvP cooldown. Combat builds only; the model counts only the sustained average.

Dual Wield Specialization.note: +10%/rank off-hand damage. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 8.7% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 8.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (8.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Precision.note: +1%/rank melee hit (parsed). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 6.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 6.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (6.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Master of Deception.note: Stealth: leveling utility. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stealth: Harder to detect in stealth (5 ranks): get the opener against alert players and other rogues; both community builds take 5/5 (audit: high; it only matters when the target faces you or detects stealth).

Opportunity.note: +4%/rank Backstab/Garrote/Ambush damage from behind. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 5.4% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 5.3% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (5.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Sleight of Hand.note: Feint threat: nothing. PvP (2026-09-27): low, avoid: -2% chance to be crit by melee and ranged attacks (warriors, rogues, hunters); the Feint part is PvE threat and the model gives the talent 0. The seal fate build's flex alternative to Camouflage (audit: medium).

Camouflage.note: Stealth speed/cooldown. PvP (2026-09-27): low, stealth: +15% speed while stealthed and Stealth cd -5 s: reach and reposition while stealthed. The community builds take 1-2 points as filler (audit: medium).

Initiative.note: 25%/rank extra CP on openers: leveling. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stealth: 75% chance for +1 combo point on Cheap Shot, Ambush and Garrote: Cheap Shot into a quick 5-point Kidney Shot. Opener only; the hemo build takes 3/3 (audit: high).

Improved Ambush.note: +15%/rank Ambush crit: leveling opener. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, burst: +45% Ambush crit: the Ambush opener crits against cloth. The spec models have no Ambush source, so this is its whole value; the hemo build takes 3/3.

Setup.note: 15%/rank CP on dodge/resist: leveling. PvP (2026-09-27): low, avoid: 45% chance for a combo point after a dodge or full resist: extra combo points under Evasion, against melee only (audit: medium; Forever's is 100% at tier 2).

Improved Sap.note: PvP/dungeon. PvP (2026-09-27): low, stealth: 90% chance to stay stealthed after Sap: Sap one player and open on another, or Sap, bandage and reopen.

Ghostly Strike.note: 125% weapon damage + 15% dodge 7s per 20s: ~5% average dodge, +1% damage. PvP (2026-09-27): low, avoid: +15% dodge for 7 s on demand against melee burst. The average is already counted as survival (audit: medium).

Heightened Senses.note: Stealth detection, -2%/rank spell/ranged hit taken. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stealth: Better stealth detection (rogues and cat druids open on you less) and -4% chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks (fewer Polymorphs, Fears, Scatter Shots). The hit part is counted as survival; the audit's optional swap for Camouflage 2 in pvp-hemo-prep.

Preparation.note: Cooldown reset every 10 min. PvP (2026-09-27): high, escape: Finishes every other rogue cooldown (10 min cd): a second Vanish, Sprint, Evasion, Blind and Cold Blood in one fight. Namesake of pvp-hemo-prep.

Dirty Deeds.note: Cheaper Cheap Shot/Garrote (parsed): PvP/leveling opener. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stealth: Cheap Shot and Garrote -20 Energy: more Energy after the opener for the Kidney Shot chain; the hemo build takes 2/2.

Hemorrhage.note: Cheap builder with a physical debuff: PvP; 0 here.

Premeditation.note: 2 CP from stealth every 2 min: leveling. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: 2 combo points from stealth (10 s window): Cheap Shot into an immediate 5-point Kidney Shot. Opener only and the 31-point Subtlety talent, which the community hemo build skips (Forever: high; 20 s window, tier 4).

Elusiveness.note: Vanish/Blind cooldown. PvP (2026-09-27): high, escape: Vanish and Blind cooldowns -90 s (5 -> 3.5 min): the escape, snare break and restealth reset plus a 10 s CC more often; both community builds take 2/2.

Improved Backstab.note: +10%/rank Backstab crit (parsed) - kept as parsed. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 5.6% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 5.5% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (5.5%). Other modes unchanged.
